  "formalization": "abbrev Account := String

-- The account the vault contract itself is deployed on. The withdrawal callback
-- may be invoked only by the contract, and a withdraw that names this account
-- as receiver sends the NEAR back into the pot.
def CONTRACT : Account := "vault"

-- The deployed vault's recorded state, plus two maps kept so the money rules
-- can be stated: for each account, the total NEAR it has really sent to the
-- contract (totalDeposited) and the total NEAR it has really received from
-- the contract through withdraw transfers (totalReceived).
structure State where
  owner : Account
  deposits_paused : Bool
  balances : Account → Nat
  totalDeposited : Account → Nat
  totalReceived : Account → Nat

-- One constructor per contract method that can change State. Each takes the
-- signing account first, then the method's arguments, then the attached
-- deposit where the method accepts one. withdraw also carries the outcome of
-- the transfer it schedules, and on_withdraw_complete the result of its
-- single promise: each call is one indivisible step in which the scheduled
-- transfer and its callback are treated as completing within that step.
inductive Call where
  | new (caller : Account) (owner : Account)
  | deposit (caller : Account) (attached : Nat)
  | withdraw (caller : Account) (amount : Nat) (receiver : Account) (transfer_ok : Bool)
  | on_withdraw_complete (caller : Account) (account_id : Account) (amount : Nat) (result_ok : Bool)
  | set_deposits_paused (caller : Account) (paused : Bool)

def step (s : State) : Call → State
  -- State exists only once the vault is deployed and initialized, so the init
  -- guard rejects every further new: nothing changes.
  | .new _ _ => s
  | .deposit c att =>
      if s.deposits_paused then s
      else if att = 0 then s
      else { s with
             balances := fun a => if a = c then s.balances c + att else s.balances a,
             totalDeposited := fun a => if a = c then s.totalDeposited c + att else s.totalDeposited a }
  | .withdraw c amt recv ok =>
      if amt = 0 then s
      else if s.balances c < amt then s
      else if ok then
        { s with
          balances := fun a => if a = c then s.balances c - amt else s.balances a,
          totalReceived := fun a => if a = recv then s.totalReceived recv + amt else s.totalReceived a }
      else s
  -- Private: anyone but the contract itself is rejected; on a failed promise
  -- the amount is credited back to the record and no real NEAR moves.
  | .on_withdraw_complete c acct amt ok =>
      if c = CONTRACT then
        (if ok then s
         else { s with balances := fun a => if a = acct then s.balances acct + amt else s.balances a })
      else s
  | .set_deposits_paused c p =>
      if c = s.owner then { s with deposits_paused := p } else s",
  "properties": [
    {
      "rule": "R1",
      "statement": "∀ (s : State) (c : Call),
  match c with
  | .deposit caller att =>
      (s.deposits_paused = false ∧ att ≠ 0 →
        (step s c).balances caller = s.balances caller + att ∧
        (step s c).totalDeposited caller = s.totalDeposited caller + att) ∧
